messages:
jordan: FYI AcmeCloud marketplace team and a couple of SI integrators (EdgeBox) asked us to add SSE streaming support for SDK/embed widgets. They want a compatibility plan + test endpoints by next-week Friday.

alex_partner: for marketplace widgets we have browsers that prefer SSE over NDJSON because of easier reconnection handling. Hardware proxies also find SSE framing simpler to implement in constrained stacks. Theyre pushing this as a requirement for new marketplace listings.

hana: timeline ask from partners is ~6-8 weeks. Can we do a dual-mode where we support both formats for a while? Also need to know what we should say in marketplace docs.

dave: Dual-mode is doable. Options:
- negotiate via `Accept: text/event-stream` (SSE) vs `Accept: application/x-ndjson` (NDJSON)
- OR query param `?stream_format=sse|ndjson` for SDKs that can't set headers easily.
Tradeoffs: SSE has built-in reconnection semantics and event types but adds ~200B of framing overhead per event. NDJSON is slightly lighter but you must reassemble partial JSON client-side.

priya: SDK plan: add `streamingFormat` option to all official SDKs (node/python/go) defaulting to `ndjson`. Provide example and a small feature flag in Console so partners can opt-in. Migration snippet (Node):

```
// Opt-in to SSE
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'rwd-legacy-stream', streamingFormat: 'sse' })
stream.on('event', (e) => console.log(e.type, e.data))
```

We should ship samples for browser EventSource and a tiny firmware-friendly parser.

dave: Implementation notes for runtime:
- add `stream.negotiation` handler that inspects Accept header / query param
- support both emitter paths; keep same token validation and KV-caching behavior
- telemetry event `streaming.format.used:{sse,ndjson}`
- default behavior: keep ndjson as default for 12 weeks, allow opt-in to SSE immediately
- add runtime flag `compat.stream_sse_enabled` (off in lower envs until canary)

alex_partner: EdgeBox asks for an official test endpoint and a reference client in C so they can validate firmware quickly. They also want the timeline in writing so marketplace reviewers can approve listing updates.

jordan: action items:
- @dave implement negotiation + smoke tests and a read-only test endpoint (owner)
- @priya update SDKs + samples and publish migration page (owner)
- @hana draft partner comms and marketplace doc blurb (owner)
- @alex_partner we'll provide a C reference client and a small harness you can run against the test endpoint

release-bot: deploy job started: `streaming-negotiation:v1` -> canary (5 nodes)

dave: ETA for PR: 4 hours. Will include unit tests for SSE framing, ndjson fallbacks, and a sample EventSource route. Will sample logs at 0.5% for format telemetry.

hana: I'll assemble a one-pager for AcmeCloud and marketplace reviewers with timelines and compatibility guarantees. Target draft by tomorrow noon.

alex_partner: confirmed: 6 weeks runway is acceptable if we provide the test endpoint + C client. Also requested that we don't flip default to SSE automatically for existing listings - ok if opt-in only.

priya: SDK release plan: patch release for all SDKs with `streamingFormat` flag + examples next week. Will mark in changelog: new opt-in SSE, ndjson default, deprecation plan for NDJSON only if partners request in future.

release-bot: deploy success: `streaming-negotiation:v1` -> canary (5 nodes) in 9m

jordan: Great. Weekly sync scheduled next Wednesday to check partner integration progress. Thanks team :rocket: :eyes:
